raw_text: The Ministry of Defence has stated that the Indian Armed Forces are fully aware of developments along the Line of Actual Control in the Pangong Tso area. All necessary counter-measures have been taken to safeguard India's territorial integrity. The matter has been raised through established diplomatic and military channels. India maintains adequate deployment and infrastructure to address any contingency in eastern Ladakh.
